name: ntfy
description: Send push notifications through your own self-hosted ntfy server. Add one or more servers with an access token in the plugin settings; Cindy encrypts each token and sends it only to its own server.
whenToUse: Use when the user wants a push notification sent to their phone or desktop through their own ntfy server, for example to be alerted when a task finishes. Requires a server and access token added in the plugin settings.

ntfy_send.description: Publish one push notification to a topic on a configured ntfy server. Returns the ntfy message id and time. topic defaults to the server's default topic. With several servers configured, pass server (id or host from ntfy_servers); ask the user if unsure. message is limited to 4096 UTF-8 bytes and is rejected, never truncated, when longer. Never resend after an outcome-unknown error (timeout, network failure, HTTP 5xx): the notification may already have been delivered, so ask the user first.

ntfy_servers.description: List the configured ntfy servers with their id, host, URL and default topic. Access tokens are never returned. Use it to choose the server argument for ntfy_send.

ntfy_conn.label: ntfy server
ntfy_conn.hint: Enter the server URL (https only, default port 443, served at the domain root) and an ntfy access token (tk_...) with write access to your topics.
